testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.wiring.DataDefinitionManagementApiTests

testcase.name: query definition lifecycle - create, list summary, full read, patch with expectedVersion, disable, delete()
a PostgreSQL data source takes only SQL the guard accepts, with every parameter declared()
without DATA_SOURCE_VIEW or MANAGE every route is 403, strangers get 404 and anonymous callers are refused()
mutation definition lifecycle on a writable PostgreSQL source()
another workspace or tenant cannot list, read, create, change or delete a definition, and cannot tell the data source exists()
a REST query definition is stored and loaded too, and an id is unique per data source()
a mutation definition needs a data source that may write, and a statement the connector can express()
an invalid query definition is INVALID_QUERY (or INVALID_PARAMS for a bad id or kind) and nothing is stored()
a mutation cannot be deleted while a write through it is in flight or of unknown outcome()
deleting the data source takes its definitions with it()
a definition change that cannot be audited is not applied()
every definition change is audited with ids, version, status and a hash - never the definition()
